services.desc: Come see us today - our friendly staff is ready to help with anything you may need! Our Paddle Boat Fleet on Lake El Estero consists of well-maintained fiberglass boats. Children and adults of all ages can ride them. Young children must be accompanied by an adult. We accept Visa and Mastercard. Ask about special rates for group events and birthday parties!​ Boat capacity is 5 people per boat with a 4 adult per boat maximum.Max capacity:

blurb: El Estero Boating offers paddle boat rentals on Lake El Estero, a small lake in the middle of Monterey city. Guests can enjoy a paddle boat ride and also access the surrounding park with picnic areas, walking paths, exercise equipment, a dog park, skatepark, playground, and fishing piers. The location is near Dennis the Menace Park and close to Monterey Beach and Fisherman's Wharf.
extraNote: On the shore of Lake El Estero opposite Dennis the Menace Park, corner of Camino El Estero and Del Monte Avenues.
